result.topic_en: Euler sets up the problem of minimizing the integral of dx·sqrt(x(1+pp)) for a curve referred to a vertical axis, and interprets it via Maupertuis's least action principle to conclude that the solution curve is a parabola (a projectile path).
result.transcription:
17
Haec igitur Paradoxa operae pretium videtur accuratius perpendere.
§. 2. Hunc in finem repraesentet EY curvam huic problemati satisfacientem, ad axem verticalem AC relatam, pro cujus puncto quovis Y ponatur abscissa $AX = x$, ipsi distantiae YV aequalis, applicata vero $XY = y$; unde posito $\partial y = p\partial x$ erit elementum curvae $Yy = \partial x\sqrt{1+pp}$, sicque formula integralis, cujus valor omnium minimus esse debet, erit $\int \partial x\sqrt{x(1+pp)}$.
§. 3. Si haec ad motum referamus, atque ponamus corpus curvam EY percurrens in singulis punctis Y celeritatem habere altitudini VY debitam, si haec dicatur $= v$, cum sit $v$ ut $\sqrt{x}$, curva quaeritur, cujus si singula elementa per hanc celeritatem $v$ multiplicentur, summa omnium horum productorum prodeat minima. At vero olim observavi productum ex spatio percurso in celeritatem convenire cum idea minimae actionis ab illustri Maupertuis olim stabilita; unde intelligitur, curvam, quam quaerimus, ipsam esse Projectoriam, quam corpus, utcunque projectum, libere describit, ideoque fore Parabolam.
§. 4. Cum igitur formula integralis, ad minimum reducenda, sit $\int \partial x\sqrt{x(1+pp)}$, si ea comparetur cum forma generali $\int V\partial x$, pro qua posui $\partial V = M\partial x + N\partial y + P\partial p$,
Mémoires de l'Acad. T. III. 3

items.quote: Haec igitur Paradoxa operae pretium videtur accuratius perpendere.
items.english: It therefore seems worthwhile to examine these paradoxes more carefully.

items.quote: sicque formula integralis, cujus valor omnium minimus esse debet, erit $\int \partial x\sqrt{x(1+pp)}$.
items.english: And so the integral formula whose value must be the least of all will be ∫dx·sqrt(x(1+pp)).

items.quote: unde intelligitur, curvam, quam quaerimus, ipsam esse Projectoriam, quam corpus, utcunque projectum, libere describit, ideoque fore Parabolam.
items.english: Whence it is understood that the curve we seek is the projectile path that a body, projected in any way whatever, freely describes, and therefore will be a parabola.

items.quote: At vero olim observavi productum ex spatio percurso in celeritatem convenire cum idea minimae actionis ab illustri Maupertuis olim stabilita
items.english: But I once observed that the product of the distance traversed and the speed agrees with the idea of least action formerly established by the illustrious Maupertuis.
